Package random

package random
Random number generation for the JSIM simulation engine. The package provides the engines, the continuous and discrete probability distributions and the distribution parameters used to characterize service and inter-arrival times.
  • Related Packages

    Description
    random.discrete
    Discrete probability distributions for the JSIM simulation engine (Bernoulli, binomial, geometric, Poisson, uniform, ...).
    random.engine
    Random number generator engines (including the Mersenne Twister) underlying the JMT distribution classes.
